info.title: OP5 Monitor
info.description: Authentication: HTTP Basic. OP5 Monitor (by ITRS Group) is a Naemon/Nagios-core network and infrastructure monitoring platform, exposing hosts, services, groups, contacts, timeperiods, and monitoring core configuration over a REST API, plus a livestatus-based filter query language for live status data and an external-command API for operational actions.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 41 of 67 upstream operations covering config CRUD for hosts, services, host/service groups, contacts/contactgroups, and timeperiods, the filter query/count API, the config change save/revert lifecycle, and the external-command API for host/service operational actions (acknowledge, downtime, comments, enable/disable checks and notifications, forced re-check). See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

servers.description: OP5 Monitor REST API server. This platform does not apply OpenAPI server variables/paths automatically — set the integration instance's server.base_path to "/api".

host.description: OP5 Monitor server hostname or IP (no protocol, no path).

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic authentication against an OP5 Monitor user account. Append "$<module>" to the username (e.g. "user$LDAP") to select a non-default authentication module.

post.description: Submits a Naemon/Nagios external command by name (acknowledge, downtime, comment, enable/disable checks or notifications, forced re-check). See the op5 Monitor command reference (per-instance at /api/help/command) for the full parameter set per command.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Name of the external command to submit.

comment.description: Comment text attached to the command.

author.description: Author name attributed to the command.

sticky.description: For acknowledgements: keep the acknowledgement until the host/service fully recovers.

notify.description: Whether to send a notification for this command.

persistent.description: Whether the comment/acknowledgement survives program restarts.

fixed.description: Whether a downtime is fixed (true) or flexible (false).

duration.description: Duration in seconds, used for flexible downtimes.

trigger_id.description: Downtime ID that triggers this one, 0 for non-triggered.

downtime_id.description: ID of the downtime to remove (DEL_*_DOWNTIME commands).

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to remove (DEL_*_COMMENT commands).

get.description: Retrieves live status and configuration data (hosts, services, hostgroups, servicegroups, contacts, downtimes, comments, log entries) using the list-view filter query language, e.g. "[hosts] state != 0".
